## What's Changed
* fix: reject MongoDB operator injection in query filter params by @theeggorchicken in https://github.com/idurar/idurar-erp-crm/pull/1423
* fix: #1215 default payment typo by @jagadish-7 in https://github.com/idurar/idurar-erp-crm/pull/1412
* fix: Profile Update Triggers Unexpected Logout on Page Refresh (closes #1163) by @ObaidBuilds in https://github.com/idurar/idurar-erp-crm/pull/1418
* fix: Multiple Search API Triggered (closes #1413) by @rpsinghcodes in https://github.com/idurar/idurar-erp-crm/pull/1416
* Fixed company logo not uploading issue#1399 by @jagadish-7 in https://github.com/idurar/idurar-erp-crm/pull/1409
* Dev by @salahlalami in https://github.com/idurar/idurar-erp-crm/pull/1432
